findings.minimal_fix: Mark Vulkan-level cross-device ownership transfer changes as REFUSED. Do not fabricate an unproved repair or false PASS. Implement a bounded, separately-labelled host-domain synchronization fallback (explicit host CPU/fence mediation labelled SHARED_HOST_BACKING_NOT_VRAM_P2P).
findings.reason: The Vulkan specification does not define distinct host-pointer imports across separate VkDevice instances and distinct vendor drivers (NVIDIA 0x10de and AMD 0x1002) as 'corresponding external resources' eligible for queue family ownership transfers via VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_FOREIGN_EXT. Foreign ownership transfers leave memory contents and aliased views undefined across independent driver instances without defined external handle correspondence. Furthermore, HOST_COHERENT does not grant cross-vendor GPU-to-GPU coherence without host-domain synchronization, and the raw VirtualAlloc pointer is not a vkMapMemory mapping.
